new_theorem.statement: In account03/B09 r38 exact dual-singleton-aggregate zero, normalize A=D0+U0 K0 U0^T with U0^TU0=I4 and q=max physical row leverage=max(q_H,q_I). If q<=1/2, rank(K0)=3 implies ||p_Q||inf<=12|pdet K0|^{-1/3}; rank(K0)=4 implies ||p_Q||inf<=8|det K0|^{-1/4}. Both are continuous-density direct O(|L|) bounds with no probability squaring. If s3(A)>=1 and ||D0||op<=tau<1, the rank-three branch is <=12/(1-tau), while rank four is <=8[(1-tau)^3 s4(S)]^{-1/4}.

rank_transition_application.statement: For balanced-sign two-frames P_N=R_N and carrier K_epsilon=[[diag(1+epsilon,0),I2],[I2,diag(1+epsilon,0)]], spectrum is {2+epsilon,epsilon,1,-1}, both singleton aggregates vanish, leverage=2/N, and dense aligned rank-one curvature remains on both banks. A 45-degree coefficient-basis change separates the two hub columns onto disjoint original-coordinate sign classes. Grouped mixed-hub smoothing gives ||p||inf <= 3e[((1+epsilon)/2)(1-2/N)^2]^{-1/3}, uniformly through epsilon=0; at N=8 the uniform bound is <12.447 and the large-N limit is 3e*2^(1/3)<10.275.

required_pinned_application.statement: For Walsh m>=8 and Q=X_h^2+4X_h<u,Y>+<v,Y>^2-<w,Y>^2 with flat orthonormal u,v,w, the pinned e5f Theorem H has mixed Gram det 4 and leverage 3/m<=1/2, hence |phi(t)|<=4pi^2|t|^-2 and ||p_Q||inf<=4, P{Q in L}<=4|L|. The target spectrum is {(1+sqrt17)/2,(1-sqrt17)/2,1,-1}.

first_unpaid_detail: Pay the exact-dual-zero diffuse rank-four carrier uniformly as s4(S)->0 when the coefficient plane is genuinely overlapping on original source coordinates, after excluding source-separated grouped mixed-hub and universal-scale fixed-pair fourth-volume exits. Do not delete the fourth direction. High carrier leverage >1/2 is separate.
